baseline.method: Logged task intervals clipped to 72 hours; activity duration assigned to next visible action/tool output within each task. Encrypted reasoning is not read. Operations classified by explicit reproducible rules. Unobserved gaps above 10 minutes are waiting/unclassified. This is an estimate, not CPU-time or a timesheet. Parallel sessions sum as session-hours; union is wall time. Remote-only MBA activity and subagents absent from local thread index may be missing.
caveats: Session-hours overlap and are not elapsed hours or CPU time.
Categories are heuristic, especially fixes versus new implementation.
The previous period had no stable comparable packet-size definition.
Testing scope and carry-over work differ, so this is a cost/coordination reference, not a causal speed benchmark.
